card.name: W of Warnings in cross-references
card.fires_on: The letter W that starts the word Warnings inside bracketed cross-references such as [see Warnings and Precautions (5.x)]. Also fires on a capital W starting 'Worsening' at the start of a bullet item.

modes.label: Warnings cross-reference
modes.description: The W of Warnings after 'see' or 'and' in a bracketed section reference.

modes.label: Worsening at sentence start
modes.description: The W of Worsening starting a sentence in a highlights list.
modes.example: Glaucoma and cataracts may occur with long-term use of ICS.<< W>>orsening of narrow-angle glaucoma

card.writes: It pushes toward word beginnings like Fort and Prop, which doesn't fit the text, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the first letter of the word Warnings when a label points the reader to the Warnings and Precautions section.
